```
['run the DIGIT programmer to flash firmware with a custom serial number to a DIGIT device', 'create a formatted DIGIT serial number from a 1-5 digit numeric string with D prefix', 'test the set_serial function to embed a serial number into a firmware binary file', 'review the find_digit_usb_dev function to locate a DIGIT USB device by vendor and product ID', 'summarize the program_digit function that invokes dfu-util to flash firmware to the DIGIT device']
```
